references.text: The same formula 'the Lord spoke to Moses' is used repeatedly in Numbers to introduce divine commands.
A parallel introductory formula where the Lord gives Moses instructions regarding laws and statutes for the people of Israel.
The same standard formula for divine revelation to Moses as preparation for new laws.
Shows the recurring pattern in the books of Moses where the Lord speaks directly to Moses with instructions.
The same revelation formula is used in Leviticus to introduce legislation from the Lord to Moses.
